criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS directly inspected: FID 218, JNSN, Helen R. Johnson Hall Of Nursing, 502 N University Street. Freshly reopened mesh ground has 12 vertices; all 12 unique source vertices lie within 0.000010 m of mesh ground vertices. Independent OSM way 117146488 is named for Johnson Hall of Nursing and is reported 0.876 m Hausdorff from the Purdue polygon.
criteria.uncertainty: Official GIS is map geometry rather than structural survey; its Shape__Area conflicts with ring area.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Reopened mesh campus-world bounds: [[-176.38357543945312, -133.98143005371094], [201.4212646484375, 244.14053344726562], [0.0, 8.135000228881836]]; ground ring matches all Purdue GIS vertices and source orientation. The plan render was directly inspected; no unexplained object transform is applied.
criteria.uncertainty: Repository geographic local approximation and map outline are not survey-controlled.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: GIS reports 3 levels. 2018 Indiana 3DEP measurement record reports 2,497 class-1 surface returns within the 3 m-eroded footprint; median above nearby class-2 ground is 8.135112 m, p95 8.18146 m. Freshly reopened roof is 8.135 m. Directly inspected 2018 Indiana orthophoto shows the matched plan footprint with a broad flat roof.
criteria.uncertainty: Tile contains no class-6 building points; class 1 can include other surfaces. Floor spacing is derived, and small roof details are not established.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.status: partly supported; remaining detail intentionally omitted
criteria.evidence: Directly inspected Purdue Archives historic record identifies legacy JNSN and lists Brick as a material; no building image is attached. Direct inspection of Google Street View panorama A9uia6rcKZF_CDi5NSntjQ shows capture date Sep 2007 and an upper horizontal window ribbon on the visible brick-faced long side, partly obscured by trees. The r2 model/render places a single ribbon on the corroborated southwest face; the eight-pane subdivision is documented as an approximation. Exterior and facade renders were inspected; entrance, canopy, limestone trim, lower facade openings and hidden-side details are omitted.
criteria.uncertainty: Low-resolution secondary panorama only supports broad appearance and ribbon position, not exact bay count/dimensions or entrance. Brick distribution on hidden sides remains unverified.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: The saved asset was opened directly before evaluation. Scene='Building_massing_johnson_hall_of_nursing_jnsn_823fca7'; expected collection exists=True; mesh count=1; vertices=144; polygons=104; modifiers=[]; linked libraries=[]; external images=[]. Building-specific raw GIS, OSM, official historical record, orthophoto, LiDAR method/statistics, evidence catalog, uncertainty notes, validation and three renders are present.
criteria.uncertainty: Panorama is referenced by ID/date/URL and was inspected directly, not redistributed locally. Master integration is outside this standalone grade.

directly_inspected_sources: Purdue Archives historic building record HTML
2018 3DEP LiDAR measurement record and calculation script
Google Street View A9uia6rcKZF_CDi5NSntjQ, capture date Sep 2007
evidence.visual_observations: Panorama shows upper ribbon and brick face partly screened by trees; orthophoto shows broad flat roof; plan and exterior renders inspected.

findings.finding: The panorama only establishes the visible upper ribbon and broad brick appearance. It cannot establish bay count, precise dimensions, entrance, lower facade, or hidden sides; the model omits unsupported features.
findings.suggested_resolution: Consult digitized Purdue Archives UA 149 slides or an elevation before adding more facade detail.

findings.finding: Roof estimate uses class-1 surface rather than dedicated building-class LiDAR returns; floor spacing is derived from GIS levels.
findings.suggested_resolution: Keep the measurement/classification caveats with the asset.
